prompt: Create a user profile management feature with correct Angular naming conventions: component, service, pipe, guard with proper file names, class names, selectors, and file organization.

assertions.name: kebab_case_filenames
assertions.description: Uses kebab-case for file names (user-profile.component.ts, user.service.ts, etc.)

assertions.name: proper_selectors
assertions.description: Uses kebab-case selectors with app- prefix (e.g., app-user-profile)

assertions.name: proper_class_names
assertions.description: Uses PascalCase class names with type suffix (UserProfileComponent, UserService, etc.)

assertions.name: modern_apis
assertions.description: Uses modern Angular 21 APIs (inject(), input(), functional guards, etc.)
